d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented In-Room Dining Supervisor to join our team. This role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the In-Room Dining department, ensuring exceptional service standards, and creating memorable guest experiences.
q: We are looking for an individual who can delight guests by supervising the In-Room Dining experiences through a detailed and guest-focused perspective. You will receive guest requests and communicate directly with the team to deliver the best personal dining experience possible, taking action on guest needs, both expressed and unspoken. Intuition and articulation will be essential in successfully mastering the role.
2 years’ experience of relevant experience in a similar role within 5* luxury Hotel, Technical education in Hospitality management or service methods is preferred.
r: Responsible for supervising the day-to-day operations for the In Room Dining Department in absence of the Manager.
To work to ensure the consistency, quality and efficiency of food and beverage service and amenities for the hotel’s guest rooms & suites. To follow the wishes and preferences of our guests.

Answer telephone using courteous, efficient telephone etiquette. Take guest in-room dining orders. Communicate special requests to the kitchen. Coordinate and deliver of orders according to Four Seasons Standards. Respond and answer guests' requests and inquiries. Anticipate guest needs, ascertain satisfaction, and offer suggestions, and respond urgently and appropriately to guest concerns and requests.

d: We’re hiring: Sales Executive, Bin Salman Lighting & Electricals (Muscat)

At BSL we design and supply lighting for villas, homes and projects across Oman. We don’t win by being the cheapest. We win because we believe in what we sell and because clients trust the service behind it.
We’re looking for a Sales Executive who sells the same way.
This role is for you if
You sell with conviction, not by begging or cutting prices
People listen to you in a meeting, and you get your confidence from knowing your product well
You’d rather visit a designer’s office than wait for the phone to ring
You take ownership: when a client trusts you, you follow through all the way to handover
r: Map the market: find upcoming villas, buildings and fit-out projects before they go to tender
Build relationships with interior designers, architects, MEP consultants and contractors
Apply for tenders and prepare complete, accurate submissions
Learn our product range quickly and turn drawings and BOQs into clear quotations
Present our lighting concepts to clients alongside our design team
Keep your pipeline organised and follow up until the deal is closed
3–5 years minimum in B2B, project or specification sales (lighting, MEP, building materials or interiors is a strong plus)
Strong Arabic and English, spoken and written
Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in everyday work: drafting proposals, researching projects, summarising tender documents, preparing client follow-ups
Valid Omani driving licence and willingness to be in the field
A boutique company where your results are visible and credited to you
Direct work with the owner, with no layers of management
Products you can be proud to present
Room to grow as the company grows
This role is not for you if you’re looking for a desk job, or if you believe the only way to close a deal is a bigger discount.

To apply, email your CV to hamza@bsalman.com with the subject “Sales Executive”, plus 3–4 lines answering this question: “Tell us about a deal you closed without lowering the price. How did you win it?”
Applications without this answer won’t be reviewed.
